evidence_summary: Simple Biz says it runs a globally distributed client-support workforce and returned to Hubstaff after trying a cheaper tracker, because reporting was not reliable. Hubstaff's LinkedIn post on 10 April 2026 repeats that the team scaled past 700 people on Hubstaff.
notes: Second source: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hubstaff_why-simple-biz-returned-to-hubstaff-activity-7448369217474637824-wWYd. Cross-check of a live case study and a 2026 LinkedIn post. Cost-sensitive: they tried a cheaper tool, then came back. Remote BPO-style workforce.

evidence_summary: Hubstaff's Simple Biz case study says the company moved from Hubstaff to Apploye to cut cost, then returned to Hubstaff because Apploye's reporting was not reliable enough.
notes: Do not prospect as an Apploye customer. The 2026 story says they left it.

evidence_summary: RocketCare, a Shopify conversion agency, says it uses Hubstaff for client time and freelancer payroll through Wise, replacing spreadsheets. Hubstaff posted the story on LinkedIn on 28 April 2026. A 15 May 2026 LinkedIn post says the same team rebranded to FONDERIE.
notes: Second source: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hubstaff_how-rocketcare-reduced-time-to-payroll-using-activity-7454907312193929216--jVT. Search FONDERIE as well as RocketCare. Seat count was not published, so spend was not estimated. Remote international team.

evidence_summary: Heeeper, a fully remote UI/UX agency with designers in Ukraine and other countries, says Hubstaff cut estimate time from 24-36 hours to 12 hours and is used for capacity planning and invoicing. Hubstaff's LinkedIn post is dated 15 January 2026, and a team member replied on 9 February 2026.
notes: Second source: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/hubstaff_how-heeeper-improved-productivity-by-35-activity-7417586956139724802-zUno. 2026 case study plus a public customer reply on LinkedIn.

evidence_summary: A Glassdoor review of RapidSeedbox says the whole shift is tracked in Hubstaff, with screenshots about every 10 minutes plus URL and keystroke logging. The reviewer was not identified.
notes: The 10 December 2024 date is on the same Glassdoor reviews page as the Hubstaff sentence. Confirm that date belongs to that sentence before treating it as a 2026 current-customer review. Complaint about screenshot and keystroke logging.

evidence_summary: A Glassdoor review says SelfDecode required contractors to install tracking software that logged keyboard and mouse activity and took screenshots, and paid only active time. A public company reply on the same page says Hubstaff screenshots are now limited to the first three months, and that full-time staff are no longer paid hourly.
notes: The employer's own reply is the confirmation. Reviewer was not identified. Screenshot use is described as limited to the trial period, so seat count is unknown. Remote contractors.

evidence_summary: A Sprout Solutions customer story about Online Specialists and Affordable Staff, founded by David Judge in Queensland with a Philippines team, says the group uses Hubstaff for contractor time, activity, and client transparency, and cites a little over 130 people after moving work to the Philippines.
notes: Same founder as Affordable Staff. Do not add these 130 seats on top of the 800-person Affordable Staff estimate until you confirm they are separate workforces. Remote Philippines team. Cost pressure versus freelance marketplaces is explicit.
